potato.name: potatoes
potato.note: In hills two feet and a half apart, in flower at midsummer.

cabbage.name: cabbages
cabbage.note: Set out in spring two feet apart, heading by July.

corn.name: Indian corn
corn.note: In hills three feet each way, in blade at the beginning of July, not yet tasselled.

pole_bean.name: running beans on poles
pole_bean.note: A pole to each hill, the vines partway up them and in flower in July.

squash.name: squashes and pumpkins
squash.note: In hills among the corn or by themselves, the runners going out in July.

cucumber.name: cucumbers
cucumber.note: In hills four feet apart; M'Mahon's July has the first fit to pick.

herb.name: pot herbs: sage, thyme, parsley
herb.note: A bed of pot herbs by the gate.

raspberry.name: raspberry canes
raspberry.note: In fruit at the beginning of July.

strawberry.name: strawberries
strawberry.note: The fruit done by July; in leaf and runner.
